claims.finding: On 2026-08-31 Gamehaus traded 7,314,900 shares and closed $0.848, up 16.5%, against 1,600 to 67,000 shares a day over the preceding two weeks (1,700 on 08/20, 1,600 on 08/21, 2,000 on 08/25) - a roughly hundredfold volume event - and nothing in the capture explains it: no filing was accepted on or around that date, the news channel returned nothing, and the entire StockTwits record for the day is four content-free posts ('dollar next', 'GFH's taking offf', two emoji). Volume collapsed straight back to 186,100, 48,200, 136,200 and 55,800 over the next four sessions and the price faded from $0.848 to $0.815, i.e. the buying did not follow through.
claims.corpus_ref: quote.json bars 2026-08-18 through 2026-09-04; filings.json (nothing between the EFFECT notice accepted 2026-08-12T04:15:26Z and the 2026-09-08 6-K except the 6-K accepted 2026-08-28T09:00:17Z); docs/cc6eb1475baeadd1dc857292e761c1a3a0fc82b4.txt (four messages, all 2026-08-31)
claims.why_not_priced: The run-up is on the tape and therefore priced as price, but its cause is not: an earnings-preview screen sees +11.95% over five days and reads it as anticipation, whereas the capture shows a single unattributed liquidity event followed by immediate volume collapse and a partial give-back. If the move had carried information about the fiscal-year print, the 6-K accepted three days earlier on 2026-08-28 would have moved the stock - it moved it +0.14% - and the follow-through sessions would not have shrunk to 48,000 shares.
claims.independence: The filings index points the same way on supply: Gamehaus filed an F-3 shelf on 2026-07-28 (accepted 10:45:45Z) and it was declared effective on 2026-08-11 with the EFFECT notice accepted 2026-08-12T04:15:26Z, so the company had live issuance capacity in hand three weeks before the spike, at a price 64.4% below its 52-week high. https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0002000530&type=F-3 . Separately, the older StockTwits digest records the same pattern at the June print - a +59.6% pre-market gap on 2026-06-08 that faded the same session ('no follow through', 'Out with small profit due to lack of momentum') - so unexplained spikes that reverse are this name's habit.
